author: HaloGuardian101
body:
Hello.

KA0S is opening applications for joining KA0S.
If you would like to apply here is the format to apply.


Timezone :
Out of 10 how would you react if you miss a scrim?
Any teams you have been in before? (If you have any)
Can you listen and talk?
Do you have skype? (If yes what is it?)
Do you have access to teamspeak?
Any skills you have?

Thank you for this good luck to all!
